title: CNN MNIST
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ architecture diagram: CNN for MNIST digit classification. 28×28 input grid, two conv+ReLU+max-pool blocks, flatten layer, two dense layers, softmax output with 10 classes. Label every block, use orthogonal arrows, fit within a single IEEE column (~8.5cm). Balanced 2D layout, not one long horizontal chain.

title: NLP pipeline
prompt: A clean NLP pipeline flowchart for text classification: raw text → tokenization → bag-of-words features → TF-IDF (optional) → SVM classifier → evaluation metrics (accuracy, F1). Use rounded boxes, clear edge labels, vertical or 2-row layout that fits an IEEE two-column figure width.

title: Flowchart
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ flowchart: Start and End as steel-blue rounded terminals, lighter blue process boxes (Read input, Process data, Report error), and a sage-teal decision diamond (Valid?) with Yes continuing down and No branching right to Report error. Copper-orange retry loop from error back up to Read input (orthogonal |- path). Stealth arrows, sans-serif labels, parametric spacing — standard algorithm flowchart, not a system architecture.

title: Model comparison
prompt: An IEEE conference comparison table: rows BERT-base, GPT-3.5-turbo, T5-base; columns MNLI, QQP, QNLI, SST-2 with accuracy scores. Use booktabs, bold best per column, compact fonts. Total width must fit ~8.5cm column without cropping.

title: Training loss
prompt: pgfplots line chart: training loss (solid blue) and validation loss (dashed orange) vs epoch 0–100. Axis labels, legend inside plot, light y-grid. Publication style, fits IEEE column width with readable tick labels.

title: Confusion matrix
prompt: Confusion matrix table for a 4-class classifier (Cat, Dog, Bird, Fish): integer counts in each cell, darker blue shading on the diagonal, lighter off-diagonal cells, booktabs rules, row/column headers for True and Predicted labels. Fits IEEE column width (~8.5cm).

title: Neural network
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ feed-forward neural network: four layers with 4, 6, 6, and 2 circular neurons, fully connected between adjacent layers. Steel-blue neuron fills with darker outlines, thin slate-gray edges drawn behind the nodes. Sans-serif gray labels under each column: Input, Hidden, Hidden, Output. Vertically center each layer, even horizontal spacing, standalone academic style — not a flowchart of boxes.

title: Ablation study
prompt: Ablation study table: variants Full model, w/o attention, w/o data aug, w/o pretrain; metrics Accuracy and F1. Bold best scores, booktabs rules, \footnotesize if needed, must fit 8.5cm column.

title: System architecture
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ system architecture: dashed gray Client on the left, steel-blue API Gateway, then Service A / Service B branching above and below, with a sage-teal Database cylinder and copper-orange Cache cylinder to the right. Dashed steel-blue Backend group box fitting the services and stores. Stealth arrows, sans-serif labels, parametric spacing — 2D architecture layout, not a single vertical flowchart.

title: Encoder–decoder
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ encoder–decoder hourglass: steel-blue Input x bar, steel-blue Encoder trapezoid narrowing into a copper-orange latent bottleneck z, sage-teal Decoder trapezoid widening to a steel-blue Output x-hat bar. Thin slate arrows along the center line, sans-serif labels, parametric sizes — block-level autoencoder diagram, not a neural-net of circles.

title: ResNet block
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ ResNet residual block: bold input x, two steel-blue weight-layer boxes stacked with ReLU between them forming F(x), a sage-teal circled + summation, then ReLU out. Copper-orange identity skip connection bows to the right and re-enters the sum. Side labels F(x), F(x)+x, and identity — classic He et al. residual learning block, not a full CNN architecture.

title: Training pipeline
prompt: Publication-quality TikZ ML training pipeline: sage-teal Dataset, steel-blue Model f_θ, dusty-plum Loss L, copper-orange Optimizer in a left-to-right row with short edge labels (forward, prediction, gradients). A copper update-θ feedback arrow loops under the row from Optimizer back to Model. Sans-serif labels, parametric spacing — training loop diagram, not a decision flowchart or microservices architecture.
